utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday the eighth of July. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Only just made it in, mind. Traffic on the ring road was dreadful.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same. Traffic on the ring road, then somebody trying to squeeze across three lanes. Lovely start.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Probably saved themselves about four seconds as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Still less frustrating than the football last night. Sat through all that for nothing.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's why I only watch the highlights. Disappointment, but quicker.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes breakfast radio. Finished work first, then what we actually need to agree.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, so I signed off the inspection on the turbine one compressor on Tuesday. That's closed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, that's yesterday's sign-off, not something going round again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the number two bearing last night. All done.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, right. I wasn't sure whether that was still hanging over from nights.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the HV board last night as well. That one's complete.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Anything from nights that's just for awareness?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, noticed the CT1 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, nothing outstanding from that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, those little blips make the handover sound worse than it is sometimes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, keeping that as an observation.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Also saw the pressure on the fire alarm panel dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, you said it came back without anyone doing anything?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Just saying what I saw, not asking for another job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's an observation, not a new action out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the AC1, nothing we can do until they arrive. Same blocker, no progress to report.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the existing parts hold. Nothing new to add from stores.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, still blocked then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: One other thing: we were going to replace the belt on the pick and place on two but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, that's off this round. Not counting it as work for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you check the guarding on the palletizer today at 2pm? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At two, yeah? Not just sometime before the end of the shift?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Today at 2pm, yes. It's urgent, so that's the one I need kept firm.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. I'll check the guarding on the palletizer today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Tomasz, can you recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve by tomorrow morning? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take that as well. With the guarding and the time I've got available, I'd be promising something I can't fit in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Dave, can you take that instead—recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve by tomorrow morning? Still fairly important.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it from Tomasz. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just the sensor calibration we're talking about, rather than work on the valve itself?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, just recalibrating the sensors. That's what I'm accepting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Dave owns that one now, not Tomasz.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While we're on tomorrow, I'll do a site visit at Northfield with the contractor tomorrow. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz. Northfield with the contractor tomorrow, agreed. Separate from the calibration you've handed over.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. I can commit to the visit, just couldn't squeeze that calibration in as well.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: A diary with actual limits. Radical stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Someone ought to tell Teams. It thinks every white square is an invitation.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test on Friday. Fairly important, so I'm keeping that one definite.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah Price. Monthly fire alarm test on Friday is yours. That's the routine test, separate from the panel observation earlier.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. I'll do the monthly test on Friday, not taking on a separate investigation from that comment.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Didn't mean to muddy the two together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you replace the seals on the boiler feed pump tomorrow? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can own it, but—sorry, just to get this in—we're still waiting on parts for the boiler feed pump, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, understood. The seal replacement is still due tomorrow, normal priority. I'm not saying the parts are here; the physical work is blocked until they arrive. Are you happy to take ownership on that basis?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, accepted. I'll replace the seals on the boiler feed pump, due tomorrow, normal priority. But I can't start the replacement until those parts arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And we've not got anything in this conversation that clears that parts hold. Just so it doesn't sound like we have.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. PR owns the replacement; the parts blocker remains. No separate new job off the blocker.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: There's still a need to take vibration readings on the Gas Turbine 2 by the end of the week. Low priority. I'm raising it, but I can't take it myself.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't commit to that one either. Don't put my name against it just because I've got the calibration.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nor mine, sorry. No room to promise that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Same here. I'm not volunteering for the readings.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, vibration readings on the Gas Turbine 2, by the end of the week, low priority. Needed, but nobody's taken them.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Not one I can pick up either. Sorry, I was nodding at the deadline, not offering.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's fine. It stays unassigned. A nod on a tiny Teams tile isn't an acceptance.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good rule. Half the time I'm just trying to get my chair to stop sinking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we've got the agreed work, the parts holds are still holds, and the cancelled belt job stays out. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
